description: React component that displays a list of pain entries with functionality to load and delete pain records, styling with Tailwind CSS.

methods.name: PainList
methods.description: React functional component that manages and displays a list of pain entries, including loading data and handling deletions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch pain data using listPain API and manage loading and error states.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a pain entry by its ID, updates state after successful deletion.
